title: Sources: Meta eyes at least $20B from a potential cross-border bond offering, the company's first major debt sale in six months and its debut offering in euros (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Meta eyes at least $20B from a potential cross-border bond offering, the company's first major debt sale in six months and its debut offering in euros — Meta Platforms Inc. is eyeing at least $20 billion from a potential cross-border investment-grade bond offering …
